games.name: Laser Pointer
games.score: points: each catch scores its combo, twice over when the pounce lands right on the dot
games.rules: Drag the dot and the cat chases it; close up, it crouches and pounces. Hold the dot still and it lands on it: a catch. Catches in a row build a combo, the dot turns golden twice a game, and catnip on the floor gives the cat the zoomies. Personality changes chase speed and lines only.

games.name: Knock It Off
games.score: points: each thing knocked off scores its combo
games.rules: The cat walks the mantel; tap and it swipes off whatever is in front of it. Things keep arriving, faster as the game goes on; hits in a row build a combo and quicken the cat, a swipe at nothing breaks it. Golden things score three times over; the catnip fish gives a longer reach. Personality changes the cat's pace and lines only.

games.name: String Chase
games.score: points: each sparkle collected scores its combo
games.rules: Draw a string with one finger and the cat runs along it. Sparkles keep appearing and fade after a few seconds; collect them quickly to build a combo. Golden sparkles score three times over; catnip gives the cat the zoomies. Personality changes chase speed and lines only.
